texts.zh:
球体外出了一片空白什么都没有。

初步的探测表明，光谱中的所有频段以完全一致的强度从所有的方向同时在向我们轰击。我们无法判断朝向。

我们的高度、深度和方向的测量设备都完全无法运转或者显然已经发生故障。看起来，围绕着我们的一片空白似乎毫无分别。

也许只要我们走得足够远就能避开这些干扰。或者我们可以在无人机的帮助下更详细地探索这个区域。
texts.en:
Outside the Sphere, there is nothing but white.

Initial readings indicate that an equal amount of every color on the spectrum is bombarding us from every direction at once. We have no way to determine our bearings.

Our altimeters, depth gauges, and compasses are completely inoperable or clearly in error. Visually, there is absolutely no deviation from the empty whiteness surrounding us.

Perhaps if we travel far enough we can escape these disruptions. Alternatively, we could explore this area in more detail with the help of a drone.

texts.zh:
我们随意挑选了一个方向往外狂奔，然后就碰上了一堵黑色的高墙。

围绕其周长航行，我们发现它接近是一个正圆。其中没有明显的入口，但表面会不时微微地颤动，仿佛是活物一般。

进一步研究表明，这堵墙的直径会逐渐增加。我们正在小心地保持着安全距离，并且随时准备着拉紧锚链撤退。

在进一步观测中我们收集到了数量可观的星界丝缕。
texts.en:
We have struck out in a random direction and have come upon a black wall.

Navigating around its perimeter, we discovered it to be a near-perfect circle. There is no visible entrance, but now and then its surface shudders ever so slightly, as if it were alive.

Further study indicated that the wall is increasing its diameter over time. We are taking precautions to keep a safe distance, and are prepared to retract our anchor at any moment.

We are collecting a sizable quantity of astral thread while we continue observations.

texts.zh:
为了从其他视角观察我们的境地，我们释放了一台无人机侦查周围区域。在以同心圆围绕着我们的舰船飞行许多圈之后，我们在不远处发现了一道弯曲的黑墙。

然而仪器的度数令人颇为不解，因为墙的高度总是精确地等于无人机的飞行高度。观察这一现象进一步加深了我们对非标准空间维度的理解。
texts.en:
To gain a different perspective on our situation, we have prepared and released a drone to scout the surrounding area. After orbiting our vessel in concentric circles, we discovered a curved, black wall not far from our location.

The readings are somewhat puzzling, however, as the height of the wall always returns equal to the exact altitude of the drone. Observing this phenomenon has furthered our understanding of non-standard spacial dimensions.

texts.zh:
我们有了新的进展。

又有一系列的墙直接出现在了我们的面前。

我们仍在维持安全距离，以免这些物体直接在我们的裂隙探球发生实体化。

也许对它们的材料进行取样，我们可以进一步理解目前的状况。或者我们可以花一些时间测绘出这些墙的外形，看看有没有什么规律。
texts.en:
There is a new development.

A new series of walls have appeared directly in front of us.

We are maintaining a safe distance lest one of these objects materialize straight through our Rift Sphere.

Perhaps by sampling their material we may further understand the current situation. Alternatively, we can take some time to map out the shapes of these walls and detect if there is any kind of pattern.

texts.zh:
我们伸出了取样臂，从墙上获取了一些黑色物质的样品。

们惊讶地发现，当我们把样品拉出来进行分析时，它保持着无限的高度。它的性质与墨水或油漆有很多共同之处，尽管颜料的成分是一种未知的类型。这种油墨中使用的一些粘合剂实际上是一种独特的溶解晶体。

我们又做了个实验，用这些样品绘制了一条线并稍作等待。很快，有一个几乎一模一样的图形平行地出现在了旁边。

我们将这个过程重复了多次，每次都使用不同量的物质，绘制成许多不同的图案。每一次图案都会被完美地以相同的朝向复制出来。

基于这些结果，我们有理由相信某种实体正在利用这些材料以进行交流。据此，我们开始用点和短线写一些基本的二进制短语。虽然它们都被完全照抄了一遍，但也有一些新的东西：我们的每个单词旁边都还出现了一个图案

我们每次写出同样的短语，同样的图案就会出现。这是翻译吗？
texts.en:
We have extended a retrieval arm and gathered a sample of the dark material from the wall.

We were surprised to find that the sample maintained an infinite height as we pulled it free to analyze it. Its properties have much in common with an ink or paint, although the components of the pigment are of a type unknown. Some of the binding agents used in this ink are actually a unique form of dissolved crystals.

As an experiment, we drew a line using a small amount of the sample and waited. A short time later, a nearly identical mark appeared parallel to it.

We repeated this action several times, each with a different amount of the material, iterating through several different designs. Each time, the mark was reproduced exactly and in the same orientation.

Given these results, there is reason to believe that some sort of entity is making use of the material in an attempt to communicate. Accordingly, we have begun writing some basic phrases in binary using small dots and dashes. These were copied exactly, but there was also something new: next to each of our words appeared a pattern.

Each time we drew the same phrase, the same pattern appeared. Is this a translation?

texts.zh:
虽然花了好几天，但我们还是完成了对这片纯白空间里的奇怪物体的测绘。

对我们而言这是一些墙和柱体，而球体的电脑可以计算出这些图案从上方看起来的样子。

图案和空间显示出明显的结构和一致性。我们可以得出结论：这些结构形成了一种我们未知语言的书面文字。

虽然我们无法理解，但球体的电脑一直致力于破译我们记录的一切。在那段时间里，有趣的事情发生了。

附近的空间里开始出现和我们的船直径一样的圆形圆柱。

我们把自己推离开一段安全的距离，却发现身后竖起了一堵坚固的墙。然而，似乎没有什么危险，因为我们一走，墙就停了下来。

有什么东西在我们身后“画”出了一条航迹。

在分析了这些符号之后，我们确信其中一个符号可以翻译成一种问候，或者简单地说：“你好。”
texts.en:
It has taken a few days, but we have completed mapping the strange objects within this white space.

While to us they appear as a series of walls and columns, the Sphere's computer was able to calculate how they would look from above.

The patterns and spaces indicate a clearly deliberate structure and consistency. The results are conclusive: the structures form written characters in a language unknown to us.

Though we are unable to understand it, the Sphere's computer has been dedicated to deciphering everything we've recorded. During that time, something interesting happened.

Circular columns identical to the diameter of our vessel began appearing in the space nearby.

We propelled ourselves to a safe distance, only to find that a solid wall was being raised in our wake. There appeared to be no danger however, as the wall stopped as soon as we did.

Something was 'painting' a trail behind us.

Having analyzed the symbols, we are confident that one of them translates into a greeting, or simply put: "Hello."

texts.zh:
又过去了几个星期。

在那段时间里，我们学会了以一种不完善的方式与这个实体交流，我们称将其之为“写作者”。这种交流很困难，但作者的语气唤起了人们的好奇和惊讶。

为了不弄乱我们的周围的区域，在每次对话之后，作者“描绘”的每个符号都被抹去，这已经成为惯例。

我们与写作者的对话持续了一段时间，最后出现了一个词语：“礼物。”

随后，一颗金色的球体出现在我们的舰船边上。这个物体与之前的符号表现完全不同，可以被我们正常地带上船。这也是我们从该实体处得到的最后的通讯。

构成它的材料蕴含着丰富的信息，我们的科学家需要花上几年才能充分理解。
texts.en:
Many weeks have passed.

Over that time, we have learned to communicate in a stunted fashion with the entity, whom we have named 'the Writer.' The exchange has been difficult, but the Writer's tone evokes curiosity and surprise.

So as not to clutter our immediate area, it has become routine that each of the symbols 'painted' by the Writer are erased after each dialogue.

Our conversation with the Writer continued for some time, until a final word appeared: "Gift."

Soon after, a golden sphere appeared next to our vessel. This object behaved much differently than the previous symbols, and could be brought aboard. This was the last communication we received from the entity.

Its component materials contain rich amounts of data that will take our scientists years to fully understand.
